If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) over last 5 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is consistently negative (≤-0.33) over last 5 days, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to counteract pessimism.  
If sentiment swings sharply (alternating ±0.33) in last 3 days, apply a 0.5–1.0% downward correction to forecast at day 16–30 to dampen volatility.  
For late horizon (16–30 days), if sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67), apply a 0.5–1.0% upward adjustment to align with mean reversion.  
If forecast exceeds true value by >3% for 3 consecutive days, reduce forecast by 1.0–1.5% per day until convergence.  
If true value drops below 70% of prior 3-day average, reduce forecast by 1.0–2.0% for next 3 days regardless of sentiment.
